name: kuda-krym
description: Сервис рекомендаций пляжей Крыма по погоде, состоянию моря и времени в пути

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kuda-krym/contracts && npm run build --workspace @kuda-krym/database && npm run build --workspace @kuda-krym/api && npm run build --workspace @kuda-krym/web
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names contracts,web,api --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @kuda-krym/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @kuda-krym/web" "npm run dev --workspace @kuda-krym/api"
scripts.validate:data: npm run generate --workspace @kuda-krym/database && npm run validate:beach-seed --workspace @kuda-krym/database && npm run validate:beach-images --workspace @kuda-krym/database && npm run validate:coastal-locations --workspace @kuda-krym/database && npm run validate:coastal-location-images --workspace @kuda-krym/database
